rules.gameplay: 1. 10 hand + 2 packets (top visible). 2. Play from hand or packet top. 3. Same suit: higher wins. Different: first wins. 4. Packet: play top, next revealed. 5. Honour from packet: may put in hand. 6. Declare buongiochi when acquired. 7. 20 tricks.
